summary: Completed FRONTEND-ONLY verification of quarantine UI interaction flow. THE KEY TEST (USER STORY 4) PASSED: clicking 'Coba Blokir Ulang' button successfully fixed the unblocked state - banner disappeared, badge changed to 0, row badge changed from RED to GREEN, and retry button disappeared. All 5 user stories verified successfully in the browser.

USER STORY 2: Both tabs exist (Semua Item Karantina and Perlu Tindakan Manual), badge shows 1 and matches banner count, 'Perlu Tindakan Manual' tab shows exactly 1 row (TEST-Q6-BTN), 'Semua Item Karantina' tab shows 5 rows
USER STORY 3: Per-row badges work correctly - TEST-Q6-BTN row has RED 'TIDAK TERBLOKIR' badge, 4 other open rows have GREEN 'terblokir' badges

USER STORY 4 (THE KEY TEST): Clicking 'Coba Blokir Ulang' button successfully fixed the issue - (a) success toast appeared with 'Berhasil memblokir 200.0 unit', (b) RED banner disappeared from DOM, (c) badge changed to 0, (d) TEST-Q6-BTN row badge changed from RED to GREEN 'terblokir', (e) retry button disappeared from the row
USER STORY 5: Empty state of 'Perlu Tindakan Manual' tab shows reassuring message 'Semua barang karantina sudah terblokir' (not the generic empty message)
REGRESSION: All 4 KPI cards render correctly (Item Tertahan, Qty Tertahan, Nilai Tertahan, Tertua)
REGRESSION: Search box filters rows correctly when typing 'BTN' (3 rows found)
REGRESSION: Status dropdown interaction works (custom SmartNativeSelect component)
REGRESSION: Action modal opens and closes correctly when clicking 'Lepas' button
REGRESSION: 'Karantina Manual' modal opens and closes correctly
REGRESSION: No red error screen detected
